responseText:
We've found a way through these caverns to a stretch of land under sky.

Yet the ramkin assault us without respite. We're not sure what they're seeking but they are murderous in their intent. You shouldn't tarry here long. 

Chieftain Sanvi Theran is organizing the newcomers in Bonfire. They will point you to where you can be most useful.

Just follow the cave beyond.
